div.head: Northu 33
div.ab: Gif preost oðerne unwarnode læte þæs, þe he wite, þæt him hearmian wille, gebete þæt.
Gif preost oðerne unwarnode læte þæs, þe he wite þæt him hearmian wille, gebete þæt.
Wenn éin Priester den andern ungewarnt lässt vor demjenigen, von dem er weiss, dass es werde (oder jener wolle) diesem Schaden bringen, büsse er das.
If one priest leaves another unwarned of that which he knows will (or of one who he knows wishes to) do him harm, let him atone for it.
If a priest leaves another unwarned of what he knows will harm him, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest allows another to be unaware of what he knows will do him harm, he is to atone for that.

note.seg: Thorpe, Schmid, Toller, Pogatscher (Anglia 23, 291) verstehen Neutrum. Mir scheint Masculinum dem Genius dieser Sprache näher; und mindestens ist der schadende Mensch mitgemeint

Thorpe, Schmid, Toller and Pogatscher (Anglia 23, 291) take it as neuter. The masculine seems to me closer to the genius of this language; and at the least the person causing the harm is meant as well
